title: 07-Digital Adaptation
description: Digital artist Amin Weber was invited to create his own adaptation of No Time To Fly. This set includes the adaptation and insights into his process.

additional_fields.html-content:
"No Time To Fly" digital adaptation by Amin Weber

This artistic response to Deborah Hay's invitation to develop a digital adaptation is linked to the sequence of the written score to the left.

on Vimeo
A dialogue about the digital adaptation with Jeanine Durning and Amin Weber during the score production session, Austin, TX (April 2013)

"Just what if where I am is what I need and I notice the feedback from that. And it’s changing every second. What if every cell in my body could perceive time passing? Time is passing, so what if every cell could perceive time passing? And that excites my body to imagine that – what if every cell could perceive time passing? So that’s another kind of question that I am using."
Deborah Hay lecture to score team February 2011
